decisions.question: S136 found nidana.model.11's Gate restricts topology-ir to ids including G3 and G7, whose cases at topology_ir_conformance.dart L508 and L821 call analyzeTopologyGraph (nidana.model.12). The gate cannot pass. How does the run proceed, and how does it avoid a third such detour?

options.label: Governance route before planning (S137 hsdd-phase-plan amend, S138 hsdd-reconcile, S139 hsdd-config re-run), with S137 checking every remaining unshipped phase's restriction (.11 to .14) against the cases and amending all in one pass
options.consequence: One detour for the rest of the node; nidana.model.12's Gate already lists G3 and G7; shipped phases stay untouched.

options.label: Amend .11 only
options.consequence: Cheaper now; a later phase could hit the same defect again (as .9 and .11 did).

options.label: Implement the analyses in .11
options.consequence: Collides with nidana.model.12's scope and its full-review tier.

decisions.chosen: Governance route before planning (S137 hsdd-phase-plan amend, S138 hsdd-reconcile, S139 hsdd-config re-run), with S137 checking every remaining unshipped phase's restriction (.11 to .14) against the cases and amending all in one pass
decisions.why: The same defect class hit nidana.model.9 (S127 to S131) and now .11; a one-pass check of the remaining restrictions costs one experiment and prevents another detour. Precedent S128 to S130.
